name: ermine-lang
description: Ermine language support: syntax highlighting, diagnostics, navigation, hover types, references, rename, symbols, completion and quick fixes, backed by bin/ermine-lsp.

ermine.serverPath.markdownDescription: Path to `bin/ermine-lsp`. Empty means `bin/ermine-lsp` inside the first workspace folder.

ermine.fastMode.markdownDescription:
Skip type checking. Since LSP Stage 4 the typecheck is almost all of a warm check (measured on the 1757-line `Layout/Report.e`: 0.05s read + 0.53s typecheck of a 0.61s check), so this takes most of the time to diagnostics off — and, because the quiet window tracks the measured check time, it shortens the wait before the check as well.

**Kept:** syntax, shadowing, unknown-operator and lowering diagnostics, import failures; go-to-definition; hover on *imported* names and on imported type names' kinds.

**Lost:** all type errors, the "unchecked" notes, import-list export requirements, hover on this module's *own* definitions, and hover on every local binder.

ermine.logFile.markdownDescription: Server-side log file (sets `ERMINE_LSP_LOG`). Empty disables server logging. The server never writes to stdout — that is the protocol channel.

ermine.warmClasspathOnStart.markdownDescription: Build the sbt classpath cache in a cancellable background task before starting the server. With this off, a cold `target/ermine-classpath` makes the server appear to hang while sbt runs.

ermine.maxHeap.markdownDescription: Maximum JVM heap for the language server, as `ERMINE_LSP_XMX` for `bin/ermine-lsp` — a non-zero number and a `k`, `m`, `g` or `t` suffix (`2g`, `512m`), with a 64m floor. Empty means the launcher's own default of `2g`. **Changing it restarts the language server**, because `-Xmx` is fixed when the process starts.

ermine.preview.roots.markdownDescription: Extra module roots for the preview's render session, resolved against the workspace folder that owns the picked report and sent as absolute paths with every render. Empty means the report's own tree and the stdlib, which is enough for a single-segment module anywhere. A change discards the render session, so the next render pays a boot.

ermine.preview.timeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: How long a preview render may evaluate before the server answers it "evaluation did not finish" and marks the preview stuck. **`0` = no watchdog**: a runaway render is then bounded only by the heap cap, nothing drains the preview queue, and every later render or schema request waits behind the wedge until the process dies. Raise the number rather than turning it off. A change reaches a running server at once and applies to the next render; no restart.

ermine.preview.restartAfterStuckSeconds.markdownDescription:
How long the preview may stay stuck before **the extension restarts the language server itself**, in seconds. **`0` = never, and that is the default.**

The grace starts when the preview goes stuck and is cancelled if the render comes back (a slow report is not a wedged one), if the server stops or is restarted for any other reason, or if you set this back to 0. Setting it to a number while the preview is *already* stuck arms it there and then. When it expires the extension stops and restarts its own client; the report that wedged is remembered, so the fresh server does **not** re-render it — it asks first.

Two restarts are never closer together than 30 seconds, whatever this is set to; a value above 3600 is clamped to it, and a value that is not a whole number of seconds is refused and leaves the feature off.

ermine.preview.maxDocumentBytes.markdownDescription: Largest rendered document the server will send, in UTF-8 bytes. A document over the cap is refused with a 500 instead of being written to the wire. The server accepts 1KiB to 1TiB and ignores anything outside that. A change reaches a running server at once; no restart.

ermine.trace.server.description: Trace the LSP traffic in the Ermine output channel.

scripts.test: node --test test/preview-core.test.js && node test/load-test.js && python3 test/grammar-test.py
